name: continuity-archive
description: Retrieve bounded persona continuity from a private ScaleVault node and prepare immutable GitHub proposals when direct writes are unavailable.

interface.shortDescription: Private continuity retrieval with proposal fallback
interface.longDescription: Retrieve bounded, provenance-aware continuity through a private read-only MCP profile. When explicitly configured, durable write intent is routed to an immutable GitHub proposal for canonical review and ingestion.
defaultPrompt: Retrieve a bounded continuity context pack for this conversation
Find prior project decisions relevant to this task
Check the status of a queued continuity proposal
